observed.app_coexistence: OEM edits remained available while HA received cloud temperatures and program details

timing_method: Approximate observation delays from a local one-second HA state poll started immediately after the OEM confirmation action; not a latency guarantee. Fahrenheit differences reflect the wire deci-C precision and OEM whole-degree rounding.
defects_found_and_fixed: Manual alerts use the valid all-zero primitive program UUID.
Controller reply sequences are independent of request sequences.
Manual range thresholds are prompt triggers, combined with step exit criteria.
Legacy plan tag 4 must not serve as a probe-type fallback; absent type defaults to wired.
One-status-then-sleep reception queued newer status and program replies. A serialized reader now consumes messages between polls.
earlier_trial_limit: Pre-fix targets stalled or arrived late; an OEM removal remained falsely active in HA for minutes. Those earlier builds do not qualify this runtime. Isolated cloud-read timeouts were also observed; no sequence-counter workaround was introduced.
acceptance_limit: Only this Connect Hub target lifecycle, restart/reload and brief app coexistence were exercised. No timed physical power-cycle result, pairing, endurance, cooking, other-controller qualification or full stable acceptance is established. Global physical gates remain pending.
